offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10000 tokens. Prototype Development: $50 for 1 Billion tokens ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: $500 for 11 Billion tokens ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC), Free.
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其URL和内容，转换为干净、适合LLM的文本；JSON模式返回五项列表。
offerings.note: 使用 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 查询；每次请求固定消耗至少10000 tokens。
